scripts.build: tsc -b packages/epistemics packages/formal-ir packages/math-ir packages/classifier packages/visual-ir packages/torchlean-adapter packages/pipeline packages/renderer-svg packages/renderer-text packages/cli
scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean packages/epistemics packages/formal-ir packages/math-ir packages/classifier packages/visual-ir packages/torchlean-adapter packages/pipeline packages/renderer-svg packages/renderer-text packages/cli && rm -rf packages/*/dist apps/web/dist
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/epistemics packages/formal-ir packages/math-ir packages/classifier packages/visual-ir packages/torchlean-adapter packages/pipeline packages/renderer-svg packages/renderer-text packages/cli && tsc --noEmit -p lean/widget/tsconfig.json
scripts.extract:corpus: node packages/cli/dist/bin.js extract --project corpus --module ProofLensExamples.Bounds --module ProofLensExamples.Monotonicity --module ProofLensExamples.Implication --module ProofLensExamples.DependencyChain --module ProofLensExamples.IntelligenceBound --out examples/corpus.formal-ir.json && node scripts/sync-corpus.mjs
